# Media fixtures

- `media.mcap` (9 KB): a spec-valid MCAP file, generated by `make_media_mcap.py`, which documents its
  layout. One robot of each kind carries media: a manipulator's wrist camera (`rgb8` `Image`), a
  quadruped's depth camera (`16UC1` `Image`), an autonomous vehicle's lidar (`PointCloud2`) and a drone
  gimbal's `CompressedImage` and `CompressedVideo` (H.264), plus a `JointState` that is not media. Every
  payload is real little-endian CDR; log time, publish time and `header.stamp` all differ. The official
  `mcap` reader parses it with CRC checks on.
- The hour-long run (`make_media_mcap.hour`, about 60 MB) is generated into a temporary directory by
  `tests/integration/test_media_job.py` and never committed.
